pages.text: All these functions are called with CALL, like your own functions. Built-in functions use their plain name. Library functions use their full name, like $(1)c0de/strings/MID$().
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/MID$(br)  PARAMETER text name ;$(br)  PARAMETER start 2 ;$(br)  PARAMETER length 3 ;$(br)  RESULT result part$()
A function with one result names it $(1)result$(). Positions in texts and lists start at 0.
